NAME: Crate Digger
DESCRIPTION: Random music discovery via Discogs crate-dig - filter by genre/style/decade/country, browse hits, and play them as a Force sound-generator voice. Built on Charles Vestal's schwung-webstream for Ableton Move (MIT); its other providers (YouTube/SoundCloud/archive.org/Freesound search) are still present in the engine but not exposed by this addon's own UI. Requires the separate ForceAudioJack addon to be enabled (arms the shared injection tap at boot, zero voices) - this toggle only starts/stops the cratedigger_host process itself, no LD_PRELOAD/acvs involved. Also requires bin/yt-dlp and bin/ffmpeg to be present in this addon's folder - see README.md/scripts/build-deps.sh. Autoload is deliberately unavailable: always start it after boot, from this page.

ARGUMENTS.NAME: module directory (module.json/bin source) - EDIT to your device's real mmPath, see README
path to ForceAudioJackSkipback's own NSMODULE.json - EDIT to your device's real mmPath, see README
